This is a targeted interpolation between the current best solution and Program 1. Program 1 improves false-clear, Spearman, pairwise accuracy, parent-floor Spearman, and negative-control gap, while the current solution retains better Macro-F1 and false-block. Splitting the differing coefficients should capture part of both profiles instead of fully accepting either tradeoff.

The base weights still sum to 1.0. The slightly larger corroboration coefficient gives consistency and quality more influence only where both positive approach and looming are present. This preserves the safety-friendly `min(a, e)` interaction: unreliable single-channel motion cannot create a large bonus, and low reliability reduces only jointly corroborated motion. The formula remains deterministic, bounded, interpretable, and essentially unchanged in runtime and AST complexity.
